primary_question: Does the B0 additive hard-prototype residual cause a general body-harm and extreme-tail-improvement pattern?
answer: The residual directly causes the frozen-checkpoint event-level prediction changes, but the general body-harm pattern is rejected. Extreme-tail benefit is stable on three datasets, while body harm is localized by dataset, quantity stratum, and seed.
confirmed: The memory-on and memory-off paths share the checkpoint, local encoder, and quantity head; only the additive B0 residual differs.
All 1814928 validation events use retrieval and receive a nonzero residual.
Intermittent, Instacart, and Taxi improve MAE and MSE above train-only p99 for all three seeds.
Instacart <=p50 is harmed on MAE and MSE for all three seeds.
Taxi p50-p90 is harmed on MAE and MSE for all three seeds.
Residual norm alone does not determine whether retrieval helps or harms.
rejected: B0 universally harms the full <=p95 body region.
Larger residual norm explains the extreme-tail gain.
This frozen-checkpoint intervention measures how a separately retrained no-memory model would perform.

insta_market_basket.interpretation: The residual improves the aggregate body and tail, but consistently harms the <=p50 stratum.

intermittent_v2.interpretation: The residual improves every quantity stratum and is strongly co-adapted with the trained local path.

raf_spare_parts.interpretation: The effect is near-neutral and not seed-stable; the >p99 scope has only 50 validation events per seed.

yellow_trip_hourly.interpretation: The aggregate body-harm and tail-benefit pattern appears, but full-body harm is driven by seed 52; p50-p90 harm and p95+ benefit are seed-stable.

design_constraints_for_b2: Provide a null-memory path instead of applying memory unconditionally.
Do not gate on residual norm alone.
Use retrieval similarity, similarity margin, local state, and residual direction in the confidence gate.
Keep similarity-weighted sparse retrieval rather than an unweighted hard top-k mean.
Log gate, null selection, residual projection, and error deltas by quantity and history stratum.
next_step: Run B1 and B2 CUDA model-tests and four-dataset e1 smokes on 5080, then perform the frozen B0/B1/B2 seed-42 matched validation screening.
